description: Defines the SymbolicShapeMeta class which manages metadata for symbolic tensor shapes, including size, stride, and contiguity properties, with lazy evaluation and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: SymbolicShapeMeta
classes.description: Manages symbolic shape metadata for tensors, including size, stride, storage offset, and various properties related to contiguity and density, with thread-safe lazy evaluation.

methods.name: refresh_numel
methods.description: Resets the number of elements to 1 and updates availability flags.

methods.name: dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions of the shape.

methods.name: has_numel
methods.description: Checks if the number of elements is available.

methods.name: has_is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the contiguity property is available.

methods.name: has_is_channels_last_contiguous

methods.name: has_is_channels_last_3d_contiguous

methods.name: has_is_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if channels-last property is available.

methods.name: has_is_channels_last_3d
methods.description: Checks if 3D channels-last property is available.

methods.name: has_is_non_overlapping_and_dense
methods.description: Checks if non-overlapping and dense property is available.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the number of elements, computing it if necessary.

methods.name: is_contiguous

methods.name: is_channels_last_3d_contiguous

methods.name: is_non_overlapping_and_dense
